name: Essential Artificial
summary: In Ironforge, Essential Artificial parts help gnomish tinkers and engineers rebuild after exile. The gnomes left stockpiles behind when they fled Gnomeregan.

sections.title: Standard Issue Ingenuity
sections.body: Before Gnomeregan fell, tinkers relied on the Essential Artificial as a component for many uses. Gnomish engineers fitted it into contraptions, clockwork wonders and heavy machinery throughout the subterranean halls. Its standard design let smiths and machinists exchange parts with confidence.

sections.title: Salvage from the Depths
sections.body:
The trogg invasion and radiation disaster drove the gnomes from Gnomeregan in a desperate rush. Large stores of Essential Artificial parts remained in heavy, steam-powered dispensers called artificial extrapolators, scattered through the deeper passages.

In Tinker Town, master craftsman Klockmort Spannerspan seeks daring adventurers to return to the contaminated ruins and recover the parts. He needs them so research and invention can continue.

faq.answer: The Essential Artificial is a standardized mechanical component. Gnomish smiths and tinkers use it in experiments, machines and contraptions.

faq.q: Why were they left behind in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: The trogg invasion and deadly radiation forced the gnomes to flee in a rush. Stockpiles of everyday components remained in storage devices.
Klockmort Spannerspan, an ambitious inventor in Tinker Town within Ironforge, seeks the parts for his experiments and technological research in exile.

faq.q: Where are they found inside the ruins?
aliases: where do i find essential artificials
faq.answer: Large, steam-powered containers called artificial extrapolators hold Essential Artificial parts throughout the deeper levels of contaminated Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As a gnome, recovering components from Gnomeregan's irradiated corridors helps your people rebuild their technological superiority while taking refuge in Ironforge.
As an engineer, you can see how these widely used parts fit varied machinery and experimental designs.
